newsitem.title: ITALY: Tender for Italy bourse stake sale seen by July 15.
newsitem.headline: Tender for Italy bourse stake sale seen by July 15.

text.p: Italy's stock market council aims to approve a tender for bidding for a stake in the Italian stock market by July 15, a statement from council chairman Francesco Cesarini said.
The council also aimed by that date to approve the calendar for the sell-off to be finished within a three-month deadline set by the Italian Treasury.

Earlier the Italian Treasury set a minimum 40 billion lire ($23.5 million) on the value of the stock exchange for its transformation into a private company, saying the sale of shares would be carried out through competitive tender with 51 percent of the stock reserved for current stock market operators.
